tasks.label: Fred (make run)
tasks.detail: Every Fred application, as make run; after make docker-up and make docker-app (or make docker-prepare)

tasks.label: control-plane-backend
args: set -m; _cleanup(){ kill -- -$$ 2>/dev/null; }; trap _cleanup EXIT INT TERM; pids=$(lsof -tiTCP:8222 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$pids" ] && kill $pids; make run

tasks.label: frontend
args: export NVM_DIR="${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}"; if [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ]; then . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" --no-use && nvm use || exit $?; fi; set -m; _cleanup(){ kill -- -$$ 2>/dev/null; }; trap _cleanup EXIT INT TERM; pids=$(lsof -tiTCP:5173 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$pids" ] && kill $pids; make run
